listenings.text: Hello, and welcome to Hotel Le Marais. This is a short message about the hotel and about the street. Your room is on the third floor, next to the elevator. There is a bathroom in every room, and there are towels in the closet. Breakfast is in the small room on the first floor, from seven to ten. There is a metro station near the hotel, only two minutes on foot. There are three restaurants on this street, and one of them is between the hotel and the park. The map of Paris is at the reception. Please ask for it. Thank you, and have a very good day in Paris.

Good morning, everyone, and welcome to Saint-Paul station. My name is Camille, and I work here. Please listen for one minute. This is line one. The train to the Louvre is on platform two, and the train to the airport is on platform four. There is a bathroom near the exit, on the left. There are two machines for tickets between the two platforms. If you have a question, I am here, at the desk, near the map. Have a very good trip today.

reading.rtitle: Hotel Le Marais -- Your Neighborhood Guide
paras: Welcome to Hotel Le Marais. This small guide is for you and your family. Everything here is near the hotel.
The hotel is on Rue de Rivoli, number 12. There is a metro station next to us: Saint-Paul, line 1. It is two minutes on foot.
There are two restaurants on this street. Le Petit Bistro is between the hotel and the metro, and it is open every day from 12 to 11.
There is a public bathroom in the park, near the church. It is open in the morning and in the afternoon, but it is not open at night.
A free map of Paris is at the reception. Ask for it, and we mark your hotel on it.
